extracted.name: Polynesian Watermelon Drink ('Otai)
extracted.description: Grate a fresh watermelon and mix it with canned crushed pineapple, flaked coconut, and evaporated milk for a refreshing taste of Polynesia.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Grate watermelon with a fork from the rind into a large bowl, leaving no large chunks. Stir water, pineapple, evaporated milk, and coconut into the grated watermelon. Add sugar; stir until dissolved. Squeeze lime juice into the watermelon mixture.
